description: Services offered by an organisation, such as biobank services
Link to the website or homepage describing the service
One or more coded values that specify what type or category of service is assigned by the biobank because of its scope (functional category).

A set of free-text keywords and/or controlled ontology terms that describe the scope, domain, methods, materials, or application areas of the biobanking or biomolecular service. Keywords support discovery, indexing, and semantic interoperability.

The technologies, methodological approaches, instruments, or computational platforms used to perform or deliver the service. This includes specific instruments, assays, pipeliines, platforms or computational implementations. (specific method, instrument, protocol)

A structured description of the operational rules governing access to the service, including eligibility criteria, approval procedures, usage conditions, cost models, and any governance or regulatory requirements.
A direct web link to detailed information regarding access procedures, application forms, governance documentation, or service entry points, if available.
The current operational and lifecycle state of a biobanking or biomolecular service within the service catalogue, indicating its availability for use and level of operational maturity.
